name: activity-monitor
description: A pane beside the chat with a live feed of Claude's tool calls and a context meter that shows memory use and whether the next command reloads context

meterColor.title: Meter bar color
meterColor.description: Color of the filled part of the context meter below the warning threshold (a name like cyan, green, or a #hex value)

barWidth.title: Meter bar width
barWidth.description: Width of the meter bar in characters (10-60)

contextWindow.title: Context window (tokens)
contextWindow.description: Size of the model's context window, used for the meter

compactAtPercent.title: Critical threshold (%)
compactAtPercent.description: At or above this percent the bar turns the critical color and the status line warns that a compaction is likely

cacheTtl.title: Default cache lifetime
cacheTtl.description: Prompt-cache lifetime assumed until a response reports its own

outgoingColor.title: Outgoing token color
outgoingColor.description: Color of the tokens sent to the model (↑, top line of each call)

incomingColor.title: Incoming token color
incomingColor.description: Color of the tokens the model wrote back (↓, bottom line of each call)

callsColor.title: Calls count color
callsColor.description: Color of the "N calls" text in the top info bar

runColor.title: Running count color
runColor.description: Color of the "N run" text in the top info bar

failColor.title: Failed count color
failColor.description: Color of the "N fail" text when any call has failed (dim when zero)

contextLabelColor.title: Context label color
contextLabelColor.description: Color of the "Context" label next to the meter bar

modelColor.title: Model name color
modelColor.description: Color of the model name in the top info bar

separatorColor.title: Separator color
separatorColor.description: Color of the | separator between the counts and the model name in the top info bar

rowSeparatorColor.title: Row separator color
rowSeparatorColor.description: Color of the horizontal line between calls in the feed

opusIcon.title: Opus icon
opusIcon.description: Emoji shown under the token counts for calls made by an Opus model

sonnetIcon.title: Sonnet icon
sonnetIcon.description: Emoji shown under the token counts for calls made by a Sonnet model

haikuIcon.title: Haiku icon
haikuIcon.description: Emoji shown under the token counts for calls made by a Haiku model

fableIcon.title: Fable icon
fableIcon.description: Emoji shown under the token counts for calls made by a Fable model

costColor.title: Cost color
costColor.description: Color of dollar spend: the cost next to each model icon and the Spent total at the top

savingsIcon.title: Cache savings icon
savingsIcon.description: Emoji shown under the model icon in front of what cache reads saved

savingsColor.title: Cache savings color
savingsColor.description: Color of cache savings: the amount under each model icon and the cache saved total at the top

otherModelIcon.title: Other model icon
otherModelIcon.description: Emoji shown for calls made by a model that isn't Opus, Sonnet, Haiku or Fable

coolingMinutes.title: Cooling window (minutes)
coolingMinutes.description: How long before the prompt cache expires the status line shows Cooling and offers ↻ to keep it warm (0-60; at most a fifth of the cache's lifetime)

warmColor.title: Warm cache color
warmColor.description: Color of the Warm status line while the prompt cache is warm

coolingColor.title: Cooling cache color
coolingColor.description: Color of the Cooling status line in the cooling window before the cache expires

idleColor.title: Idle time color
idleColor.description: Color of the idle time on the cache status line while the cache is warm

idleLateColor.title: Idle time color near reload
idleLateColor.description: Color of the idle time in the cooling window, when the next command is close to needing a reload

warnAtPercent.title: Warning threshold (%)
warnAtPercent.description: At or above this percent the bar turns the warning color

warnColor.title: Warning bar color
warnColor.description: Bar color between the warning and critical thresholds

criticalColor.title: Critical bar color
criticalColor.description: Bar color at or above the critical threshold

askCompactFocus.title: Ask for compact focus
askCompactFocus.description: When the context bar is clicked, ask what the compaction summary should focus on (like /compact <focus>). Enter on 'Compact now' skips it

showTargets.title: Show call targets
showTargets.description: Show each call's target (file, command, pattern) after the tool name. Show Commands in the model list (click the model name) overrides this for the session; while hidden, click a tool name to show its target

totalsLabelColor.title: Token totals label color
totalsLabelColor.description: Color of the Tokens:, Cached: and Written: labels on the token totals lines (blank = dim)

totalsValueColor.title: Token totals value color
totalsValueColor.description: Color of the numbers on the token totals line (blank = dim)

okIcon.title: Succeeded icon
okIcon.description: Mark beside a call that worked (an emoji or a character such as ✓)

errorIcon.title: Failed icon
errorIcon.description: Mark beside a call that failed (an emoji or a character such as ✗)

warmIcon.title: Warm cache icon
warmIcon.description: Mark in front of Warm on the cache status line

coolingIcon.title: Cooling cache icon
coolingIcon.description: Mark in front of Cooling on the cache status line

logFolder.title: Log folder
logFolder.description: Folder that Save Log writes to (blank = claude-activity-logs in your home folder)
